"""Stress: 2048 runs, 4096-state machine, long preambles, distinct identities."""
import base64, json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from kbuild import *

NS = 4096
NRUNS = 2048
STATES = ["INITIAL"] + ["s%d" % i for i in range(1, NS)]
types = [
    {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": STATES},
    {"name": "Msg", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4},
]
mod = {"name": "m", "params": [["state", "State"], ["message", "Msg"]],
       "result": ["res", "Msg"], "requires": None}
# chain INITIAL->s1->...->s4095, cost 1, cmd "c%04d"; plus an alt edge for ties
transitions = []
for i in range(NS - 1):
    transitions.append({"from": STATES[i], "to": STATES[i + 1], "command": "c%04d" % i,
                        "cost": 1, "when": None})
# a tie-heavy fan: from INITIAL jump to any even state at matching cost via "z" chain? skip; add loop
transitions.append({"from": STATES[-1], "to": STATES[-1], "command": "loop", "cost": 1, "when": None})
machine = {"states": STATES, "initial": "INITIAL", "state_param": "state",
           "message_param": "message", "transitions": transitions}

def mchars(s, n=4):
    return [ord(c) for c in s.ljust(n, '\x00')]

def mk(state_idx, msg):
    seq = [("x0", le(state_idx, 4))]
    for i in range(4):
        seq.append(("x%d" % (2 + i), le(mchars(msg)[i], 1)))
    for i in range(4):
        seq.append(("x%d" % (7 + i), le(0, 1)))
    return {"entry": "m", "ktest": b64(ktest(seq))}

runs = []
for r in range(NRUNS):
    # target states 1..NRUNS; distinct messages -> distinct identities
    runs.append(mk(1 + r, "m%03d" % r))

campaign = {"types": types, "modules": [mod], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["m"], "machine": machine, "runs": runs}
data = json.dumps(campaign).encode()
print("input bytes:", len(data))
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py'],
                   input=data, capture_output=True)
dt = time.time() - t0
print("rc=%d time=%.1fs out=%d stderr=%s" % (p.returncode, dt, len(p.stdout), p.stderr[:200]))
out = json.loads(p.stdout)
assert all(r['status'] == 'READY' for r in out['records'])
total_cmds = sum(len(c['commands']) for c in out['corpus'])
total_chars = sum(sum(len(x) for x in c['commands']) for c in out['corpus'])
print("corpus:", len(out['corpus']), "commands:", total_cmds, "chars:", total_chars)
c = out['corpus'][1000]
assert c['inputs']['state'] == 's1001'
assert c['commands'] == ["c%04d" % i for i in range(1000)] + [c['inputs']['message']]
assert c['cost'] == 1000
print("stress1 OK")
EOF
